call_points.text: No numeric revenue or margin guidance; management only said greenfields should contribute to the bottom line in one or two quarters.
Q1 revenue grew 37%, of which 7% was copper inflation; the rest volume, content, premiumisation and new model launches.
EVs contributed 8.5% of Q1 revenue; company is engine-agnostic across ICE and EV platforms.
NCR minimum wages rose 30-40%; the mandated increase is fully reflected in Q1 results, other states not concluded.
Employee cost was INR600 crores in the quarter; management declined to quantify the wage-hike portion separately.
Greenfield plants held revenue at about INR450 crores run rate and break-even, same as the previous quarter.
FY27 budgeted capex will be funded from internal accruals.
Wage pass-through talks with customers have no timeline; management would not commit to a share of the impact recovered.
FY27 capex guided at ~₹200 Cr, in line with the current year, split across greenfield, automation and replacement.
Greenfield plants at Kharkhoda (~80%), Navagam (~60%) and Pune (~50%) are ramping; Pune volumes remain below forecast.
Winning business across ICE, EV and hybrid powertrains; FY26 revenue grew ~33% vs single-digit market growth.
Pune plant volumes delayed; management says profitability parity with existing plants will take a few more quarters.

operating_notes.text: Copper constitutes 24-28% of raw material cost; a sequential 18% copper price increase contributed about 5% to Q4 revenue growth.
Greenfield plants generated ₹443 Cr revenue in Q4FY26, with Kharkhoda at ~80% utilisation, Navagam ~60% and Pune ~50%.
FY26 greenfield net start-up cost was ₹127 Cr, with management unable to isolate the one-off portion.
Copper pass-through lag remains 3-6 months, with a 7% delta unrecovered in Q1FY27 versus 17% in the preceding quarter.
Greenfield plants ran at about INR450 crores quarterly revenue and break-even, flat on the previous quarter.
EVs were 8.5% of Q1FY27 revenue; management targets ROCE above 40%.
